Kavya Rao: Wrapping up runtime section — putting follow-ups here.
Ben Ortiz: Confirm hosted p95 numbers and measurement profile?
Kavya Rao: Hosted p95 target = 120ms (8k context, steady-state, default quantized path). Dedicated committed SLA = 100ms p95. Cold-starts are separate.
Rina Das: Does the p95 assume int8/4bit only? Our fp16 runs differ.
Kavya Rao: Yes default quantized serving; fp16 typically +10-25ms depending on model.
Marco Silva: Batching heuristic: will latency_budget_ms be per-route? We saw tails when global dynamic batching flipped on.
Kavya Rao: Yes. Default runtime is latency-first (stop on latency_budget_ms or max_batch_size). Per-route override available for throughput-first. Aggressive dynamic batching behind per-route canary.
Ben Ortiz: Can someone post the exact latency_budget config snippet so infra can emulate locally?
Kavya Rao: I'll drop a YAML snippet in this thread today.
sre-oncall: KV eviction question: a tenant experienced tail latency when global pressure eviction ran. Any mitigations?
Marco Silva: Short-term: increase tenant TTLs and lower pressure; long-term: LRU per-tenant with protected recent-prefix segment and eviction_reason metrics.
Kavya Rao: Action: Runtime team to publish eviction algorithm + metrics (eviction_count, eviction_reason, eviction_ttl_expiry).
Rina Das: Tracing: need per-kernel spans (matmul/attn/softmax) in Console; current spans are too coarse.
Kavya Rao: Runtime will add kernel_name/kernel_ms/kernel_device spans behind a feature flag next sprint.
Ben Ortiz: Hotpatch fallback: we had a partial hotpatch that left hung requests. Who owns trace dive?
Kavya Rao: SRE + Runtime. Please drop trace ids here.
Marco Silva: Example trace ids I have: trace-2026-12-02-11, trace-2026-12-02-13.
deploy-bot: queued deployment: runtime/kernel-vector-proto -> canary group zeta (job 11007) :rocket:
Kavya Rao: Recap actions: Ben to run local tests with latency_budget YAML, Runtime to publish eviction doc + kernel spans, SRE+Runtime to triage hang traces, Kavya to post rollout checklist. Ping me for anything missing.
Ben Ortiz: will post gist to #eng-runtime later today.
Rina Das: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
